## 1. Statutory Protection Summary (Germany & EU)

- **Computer Program & Algorithm Protection (`§§ 69a–69g UrhG` & `EU Directive 2009/24/EC`):** Covers all source code, compiled binaries (`SpaceLumin.exe`, Android APK), and proprietary mathematical algorithms (`PredictiveAI`, `NystromKernel`, `NeuroFlowController`, `CognitiveOverloadDetector`, `KernelMapper`, `EnemyDNA`, `Director`, `PlanetAtlas`, `DataScreeningService`).
- **Anti-Circumvention & Watermark Protection (`§§ 95a, 95c UrhG`):** Prohibits bypassing `CopyrightGuard.js` runtime anti-cloning locks, frame-busters, or removing cryptographic Rights Management Information.
- **Anti-Scraping / TDM Opt-Out (`§ 44b Abs. 3 UrhG` & `Art. 4(3) EU DSM Directive 2019/790`):** Machine-readable opt-out enforced via HTTP header `TDM-Reservation: 1` and HTML meta tags.
- **Privacy-by-Design Telemetry (`Art. 25 GDPR / DSGVO`):** `DataScreeningService.js` screens and aggregates purely pseudonymous kinematic/game-state metrics without collecting personal identity, IP addresses, or device fingerprints.
